title: Restore generation of the previously selected three default products

requirements.text: Update the app’s default three products so they match the previously selected themes (Digital Planner, Canva Templates, Printable Wall Art) and ensure each default product is prefilled with complete starter content (name, subtitle, description, modules/chapters, AI prompts, templates, and checklists) so users can generate all three fully built products immediately on first launch.

quotes: are you still able to generate the three fully built products that were chosen before?

acceptanceCriteria: On a fresh browser profile (no localStorage drafts), the Product Editor loads with three products whose themes are Digital Planner, Canva Templates, and Printable Wall Art.
Each of the three defaults contains non-empty starter content for: modules/chapters, prompts, templates, and checklists (not just name/description).
Clicking “Generate All Products” successfully produces 3 bundles and navigates to the Export screen with all three bundles available for download.

requirements.text: Prevent existing local drafts from unintentionally overriding the updated default products by bumping the local draft storage version/key and providing a safe fallback behavior (e.g., treat older draft versions as incompatible and start from the new defaults).

quotes: are you still able to generate the three fully built products that were chosen before?

acceptanceCriteria: If a user has older saved drafts from the previous default products, the app does not load those drafts over the new default themes; instead it starts from the new defaults.
Newly saved drafts persist and reload correctly after a page refresh.

constraints: Keep all user-facing text in English.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or other frontend immutable paths defined by SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (no additional backend services).
nonGoals: Adding new product slots beyond the three default products.
Introducing any external database or third-party authentication beyond Internet Identity.
Changing the export/download feature set beyond ensuring the three selected products can be generated.
